title: The Albion Skiffle Company
summary: Live skiffle music featuring authentic tracks, unexpected covers, and traditional instruments like washboard, tea chest bass, guitars, banjo, mandolin, fiddle, and uke.

title: Made for Giving: pop-up gift shop
summary: Two-week pop-up shop of original gifts from 20 local artists, makers and designers, with a launch evening from 6pm to 8pm on Thursday 26 November.

title: Kushty Rye
summary: Kushty Rye plays classic songs in the style of Folk, Country & Blues at The Seadog.

title: Palmerama’s Comedyrama
summary: Hastings’ longest running monthly comedy night features six acts from around the south east, hosted by local comedian Dan Palmer.

title: Amuse Bouche comedy writing taster
venue: Downstairs bar, White Rock Hotel, Hastings
summary: A female-powered introductory workshop in comedy writing, ad libbing, improv and flash fiction, run by Lindsay Jayne, Nicky Torode, Nicola Reading and Stella Valente. No experience needed, just a sense of humour.

title: Christmas Tree Festival, St Clements Church
venue: St Clements Church, Hastings Old Town
summary: Decorated trees themed 'Christmas Characters', a craft fair and refreshments open the festival, which runs until 6 December with trees by treelight, handbells, border Morris and live music.

title: TAKE ME TO CHURCH
summary: More Fountains and Metalheadz team up for a Blue Note Session featuring DJ Storm, Dillinja, Loxy and Elm Street in an acoustic church space.

title: Ben Maier & the Maier Brothers
summary: Hastings singer-songwriter Ben Maier is joined by his brothers for a one-off family performance at Mike's Shop.

title: NORTHERN SOUL DAY PARTY
summary: The Northern Soul Day Party comes to Blackbox for an afternoon of rare soul records and dance floor favourites. Tickets are available from £12.50.
